prerequisites: Permission to view Referrers and an authorised site. Genuine successful referral-bearing HTML requests are needed for populated counters.
task: Select the site and reporting window and apply the filters. Visit a public HTML page through a genuine referring link, then refresh the report.
expectedResult: Measured referral sources appear for the selected window; empty results mean no eligible requests were measured.
nextStep: Compare sources over another window and inspect the public tracking prerequisites if the expected request is absent.
